risk_summary: The disclosure is detailed and includes quantified acquisition, impairment, ownership, and license-expiration information, but is lengthy and contains substantial standard business-description language. Key risks include the $347.2 million goodwill impairment, dependence on Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger licenses, competitive fashion markets, and reliance on uncertain growth initiatives. Overall tone is strategically optimistic but materially tempered by concentration, impairment, and execution risks.
